planets.name: TOI-5716 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5716 with a 6.77-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5716 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5716. Its orbit and size follow Gomez Barrientos et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
